This '''individual''' worked as the night desk clerk for the [[Junavex Hotel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3964 BBY]]. He was described as a "family friend" of the self-proclaimed [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] industrialist [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Marn Hierogryph|Hieromarn]].
